cause.label: dilution_or_going_concern
cause.what_happened: No company news on 2026-10-01; the fall continues a -26% day on 2026-09-30 that followed a resale F-3 filed after the close on 2026-09-28 (17:11 ET) registering 3,521,337 shares from a $600k toxic convertible note, its warrant and reset Series A warrants, against 1,635,990 shares outstanding; the only 9/30 release (06:55 ET) re-announced an August acquisition and is not a plausible cause of a fall.

evidence.claim: F-3 resale registration of up to 3,521,337 ordinary shares (960,301 Series A warrant shares at $1.6148, 2,112,677 Sixth Note conversion shares, 448,359 note-warrant shares); 1,635,990 shares outstanding as of 2026-09-28; 1-for-11 reverse split effective 2026-07-31; last sale $1.49 on 2026-09-25
Sixth Promissory Note, $600,000 principal for $540,000, issued 2026-09-17, convertible at the lower of $1.420 or 88% of the lowest 20-day VWAP, floor $0.284; note warrant for 448,359 shares
Shares outstanding were 557,464 right after the 1-for-11 reverse split of 2026-07-31, so the count roughly tripled to 1,635,990 by 2026-09-28
The only press release near the fall (2026-09-30 06:55 ET) re-announced Fort Technology's 50.1% Logia USA stake, closed 2026-08-26 for ~$125k of Fort shares; no financing or listing content

pipeline.next_dated_event: SEC effectiveness of the 2026-09-28 resale F-3; not dated. Precedent: the 2026-05-18 F-3 went effective 2026-05-29 and the June F-3/F-1 on 2026-07-09, each preceded by a CORRESP acceleration request, and none is on EDGAR as of 2026-10-01, so effectiveness inside the window is unlikely
pipeline.what_would_change_my_mind: A CORRESP acceleration request or EFFECT notice for the 2026-09-28 F-3 dated on or before 2026-10-02 (more supply, larger negative), or a 6-K showing the note holder's conversions stopped or a buyer stepping in (toward 50 or above).

positioning_check: Short interest 60,458 shares at the 2026-09-15 settlement, down 31.1% from 87,756 on 2026-08-31, days to cover 1.0 (Nasdaq, https://api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/NEXR/short-interest?assetclass=stocks); about 3.7% of the 1,635,990 shares outstanding on 2026-09-28 per the F-3. Settlement lags ~8 business days, so the position carried into the 9/30-10/1 fall is not observable. No insider trades in 3 or 12 months. No options market, so no skew.

findings.finding: A toxic convertible structure keeps a price-insensitive seller in the stock through 2026-10-02: the Sixth Note converts at 88% of the lowest 20-day VWAP (floor $0.284) and a resale F-3 filed 2026-09-28 registers 3.52M shares, more than twice the 1.64M outstanding, after the share count roughly tripled since the 2026-07-31 reverse split.
findings.mechanism_in_window: Not a dated event: the supply is continuous. Each lower print lowers the conversion price and raises shares per dollar for the holder of the earlier, already-registered notes (424B3 supplement 2026-09-01), so conversion selling can continue in the 2026-10-02 session. The F-3 shares themselves cannot be resold until it is effective, which on precedent is later than the window.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Since the June 2026 financings this name has fallen 10%+ twelve times in four months (baseline events 2026-06-09 to 2026-09-30); next-close moves split 5 up / 7 down with a median around -1%, and the two big bounces (+33.9% on 07-28, +28.7% on 07-30) came in the reverse-split week rather than under ongoing conversion supply.
findings.why_not_priced: The price has taken the registration as news (-26% and -14.6% over two sessions) but not the structure: a conversion price indexed to the lowest VWAP means the seller is not finished at any given price, and nothing in the record shows the note holder stopped. If the price had taken this fully, the bounce rate on its comparable falls would not be 44% and volume would show capitulation rather than 0.52x normal.
findings.independence: The 2026-09-22 6-K gives the conversion formula and the 2026-07-24 6-K the post-split share count of 557,464, against 1,635,990 two months later: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1885408/000121390026102195/ea0306226-6k_nexera.htm and https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1885408/000121390026081359/ea0299008-6k_nexera.htm

outside_window.finding: SEC effectiveness of the 2026-09-28 resale F-3 (3,521,337 shares) releases registered note-conversion and warrant supply; precedent suggests about 11-16 days after filing, i.e. around 2026-10-09 to 10-14, preceded by a CORRESP acceleration request

Nasdaq $1 bid price: at $1.11, and because of the 1-for-11 reverse split on 2026-07-31 the F-3 warns there is no compliance period if the shares close under $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days, so a delisting determination would follow directly; the earliest it could arrive is mid-November
Further anti-dilution resets of the Series A and June 2026 warrants (reset to $0.372944 on 2026-07-21, $2.398704 on 2026-08-13, $1.6148 on 2026-09-03), each announced by 6-K on no fixed date
